newsitem.title: UK: Sakura Bank $600 mln FRN due next week - Merrill.
newsitem.headline: Sakura Bank $600 mln FRN due next week - Merrill.

text.p: Sakura Capital Funding (Cayman) Ltd is expected to launch a $600 million step-up perpetual FRN early next week, joint lead manager Merrill Lynch International said on Friday.
The issue will be guaranteed on a subordinated basis by Sakura Bank Ltd, and is expected to be rated Baa2 by Moody's and BBB by Standard & Poor's.
Sakura Finance International will be the other joint lead manager.
The deal will pay a coupon of three-month Libor plus 90 basis points, which will step up to Libor plus 240 b.p. if not called in the fifth year.
Issue and reoffer price was expected to be par, Merrill Lynch said.

Sakura launched a $1.0 billion perpetual issue via Merrill Lynch in February, in a move to expand its investor base away from Japan. That deal was split into a $400 million fixed-rate tranche and a $600 million FRN, both with calls after five years.
